item.title: Episode 2 – First steps with high school students: 5 workshops to decode digital challenges
item.author: vincent.loiseau@sustainablemind.tech (Vincent Loiseau)
item.description: A first series of five workshops introduced 12 tenth-grade students to the environmental and ethical challenges of digital technology, sparking high engagement and meaningful questions.

item.title: Episode 1 – When Teachers Commit to More Responsible Digital Practices
item.author: vincent.loiseau@sustainablemind.tech (Vincent Loiseau)
item.description: A participatory conference at Jeanne d’Arc Middle School in Gex helped raise awareness among twenty teachers about the challenges of responsible digital practices, paving the way for the co-creation of a future course for 8th-grade students.

item.title: Introduction - Responsible Digital in Action: Feedback from the Jeanne d’Arc Institution

item.title: Environmental impact of social media
item.author: vincent.loiseau@sustainablemind.tech (Vincent Loiseau)
item.description: According to the We Are Social 2024 report, 78% of French people regularly use social media, with an average of 6 different platforms per month. However, some applications like TikTok break records in terms of time spent (38h38/month) and… environmental impact! Discover the full analysis of these digital trends in this article.

item.title: Software environmental impact
item.author: vincent.loiseau@sustainablemind.tech (Vincent Loiseau)
item.description: Software, although virtual, has a real environmental impact. The proliferation of bloatware is adding to the carbon footprint of digital technology. Software eco-design is the key to a more sustainable future.
